name: How long does a spa-inspired primary bathroom remodel typically take from design to completion?

mainEntity.name: How long does a spa-inspired primary bathroom remodel typically take from design to completion?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a spa-inspired primary bathroom remodel varies depending on the project's complexity and the extent of custom features. Generally, these comprehensive renovations, involving structural changes, new plumbing, electrical work, and high-end finishes, can span several weeks to a few months. Our integrated design-build process is structured to optimize efficiency; however, we prioritize craftsmanship and meticulous execution over rushing the project. We provide a detailed project timeline upfront, maintaining clear communication throughout each phase.
